name: Man Matters Shilajit Gummies
ingredients_raw: Shilajit (Asphaltum punjabianum) resin 400mg, KSM-66@ Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) Extract 40 mg, Ginger (Zingiber officinale) Extract 10 mg, Black Musli (Curculigo orchioides) Extract 6 mg, Gokshura (Tribulus Terrestris) Extract 6mg, Kaunch (Mucuna Pruriens) Extract 6 mg, Akarkara (Anacyclus pyrethrum) Extract 4 mg, Black Pepper (Piper nigrum) Extract 2 mg. Excipients: Chicory Root Inulin (Prebiotic), Pectin, Citric Acid, Natural Flavor (Tamarind), Maize Starch, Guar Gum
